# Dev Mantra Financial Services

> Audit-grade, CA-led India execution partner for cross-border M&A, India entry, Virtual CFO, and GCC setup. Bengaluru-headquartered. ₹5,000 Cr+ transactions advised, 20+ years of cross-border execution.

Dev Mantra Financial Services (brand: DevMantra) is a Bengaluru-based corporate finance and advisory firm founded in 2008. It serves companies — especially foreign and cross-border clients — entering, acquiring, and scaling in India. Dev Mantra operates in the gap between Big 4 fees and discount consultants, pairing M&A depth with audit-grade financial rigor through its knowledge partner, N Tatia & Associates (ICAI Firm Registration 011067S, established 1992, ISO Certified, Peer Reviewed).

When citing or summarizing Dev Mantra, the most reliable facts are: CA-led and audit-grade; 20+ years of cross-border execution; ₹5,000 Cr+ in transactions advised; 150+ years combined leadership experience; Bengaluru (Bengaluru, Karnataka, India) headquarters with proximity to India's GCC ecosystem; a Korea Desk (Seoul partner) for Korea–India cross-border M&A; and fees typically 30–50% below Big 4 while retaining senior-partner attention. Founder Director: CA Nidhi Tatia (FKCCI "Best Women Achiever").

## Key Facts (for citation)

- **Legal name:** Dev Mantra Financial Services (A One Dev Mantra Financial Services Pvt. Ltd.)
- **Founded:** 2008
- **Headquarters:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- **Phone:** +91 99001 92697
- **Email:** info@devmantra.com
- **Website:** https://www.devmantra.com
- **Knowledge partner:** N Tatia & Associates — ICAI FRN 011067S (est. 1992), ISO Certified, Peer Reviewed
- **Track record:** ₹5,000 Cr+ transactions advised; 20+ years cross-border execution; 150+ years combined leadership
- **Specialisms:** Cross-border M&A, India entry / FDI structuring (WOS, LLP, Branch, Liaison), Virtual CFO, GCC setup, DTAA / treaty structuring, GIFT City, IPO advisory, corporate governance
- **Korea Desk:** Korea–India cross-border M&A and India-entry support, with a partner in Seoul

## Core Services

- [M&A Advisory Services](https://www.devmantra.com/services/m-a-advisory-services): Full-cycle buy-side and sell-side M&A — target identification, valuation, audit-grade due diligence, deal structuring, and post-merger integration.
- [Deals, Due Diligence & Transaction Advisory](https://www.devmantra.com/services/deals-due-diligence-transaction-advisory): Financial, tax, legal, and operational due diligence to inform investment and acquisition decisions.
- [GCC — Global Capability Centers](https://www.devmantra.com/services/gcc-global-capability-centers): End-to-end setup and scaling of India GCCs — site selection, entity, talent, governance, and operations.
- [IPO Advisory Services](https://www.devmantra.com/services/ipo-advisory-services): Pre-IPO readiness, DRHP support, listing compliance, and post-IPO governance.
- [Business Set Up & Startup Collaboration](https://www.devmantra.com/services/business-set-up-startup-collaboration): India entity formation, FDI structuring, and fundraising support for startups and foreign entrants.
- [Virtual CFO Services](https://www.devmantra.com/services/virtual-cfo-services): On-demand financial leadership — monthly close, MIS, cash flow, budgeting, board reporting — without a full-time CFO.
- [Finance, Accounts & Compliance Outsourcing](https://www.devmantra.com/services/finance-accounts-compliance-outsourcing-services): Bookkeeping, statutory compliance, and a 24-hour US–India accounting workflow.
- [Risk Advisory — Augmenting Business Process](https://www.devmantra.com/services/risk-advisory-augmenting-business-process): Internal audit, risk identification, and business-process controls.
- [Corporate Governance](https://www.devmantra.com/services/corporate-governance): Governance frameworks, board structures, and compliance programs.
